faq: Does eBay allow custom HTML in listings?
eBay allows simple HTML and CSS, but blocks scripts, active content and external links in descriptions. We build the template to those limits so that your listing is not removed for a policy reason.
Will it work with the eBay app?

Yes, we test on a phone screen and keep the layout single-column, with short text blocks and images that scale. Some eBay mobile views simplify a description, so we make sure key facts also sit in item specifics.
Can I edit the template myself later?
Yes. We mark the parts you change, like the item name and photos, with clear labels, and send a short guide. If you prefer, we can update the file for you through the add-ons.
Will you add a store logo or banner?
Yes, using files you send, or a simple text logo if you have none. We do not use brand names or images you do not own or have rights to.
